source: One limiting resource is enough to stop additional blocks from becoming resident. A kernel that barely uses shared memory can still be register-limited. A kernel with modest register use can be shared-memory-limited. Very small blocks can hit the block-count limit before filling the available thread slots.[1]
zh: 一种有限的资源足以阻止其他区块驻留。几乎不使用共享内存的内核仍然可能受到寄存器限制。具有适度寄存器使用的内核可能会受到共享内存限制。非常小的块在填充可用线程槽之前可能会达到块计数限制。[1]
